system_name: Trigun Interactive Mystery Kit — Layout Templates
note: STYLE-INDEPENDENT layout templates. Each structure_block describes ONLY composition/structure (no medium, palette, or finish words) so the SAME layout renders identically across ANY KBS visual style. Style comes from the chosen style_lock; layout comes from here. Every page is a FLAT printable A5 image (or a 4cm square for puzzle pieces). The renderer prepends the global printable_rule and appends the chosen style DNA + any needed character lock_lines/refs. 'layout_reference' points at the native PDF example — attach it for composition fidelity when rendering in the native Trigun style; for OTHER styles rely on the structure_block so the layout repeats while the look changes.
a5_spec: A5 portrait, 148x210mm, 3:4-ish aspect; full-bleed flat artwork, no physical-object framing.
piece_spec: A single 4cm x 4cm square tile, full-bleed flat artwork.

templates.name: Main Cover Page
templates.structure_block: COVER layout. A strong central vertical composition: the TITLE in large display lettering across the upper third, a smaller subtitle line beneath it, and a thin decorative rule. In the central field, the hero figure (the girl protagonist holding an ancient book) stands before a faded Rajasthani haveli silhouette, with three faint, semi-translucent female figures arranged behind her (one warm/active, one dark/still, one pale/calm). A small age badge sits in a lower corner and a short tagline runs along the bottom edge. A decorative double border frames the whole page just inside the bleed. Balanced, mysterious, inviting.

templates.name: Intro Poem / Riddle Sheet

content_slots.heading: The Asura-s Song
content_slots.footnote: Read it the way the proud always speak — they hide things in plain sight.

templates.structure_block: POEM SHEET layout. A small ornamented heading at the top, then the riddle poem set as centred couplets with generous line spacing down the middle of the page, each couplet visually separated. A faint decorative motif (a small three-part emblem) sits above the poem and a single italic footnote line sits at the bottom. A decorative border frames the page. Calm, ceremonial, readable — the poem is the hero.

templates.name: Graphic-Novel Story Page
templates.structure_block: GRAPHIC-NOVEL PAGE layout. Divide the page into 3 to 6 comic panels of varying size with clear gutters between them (e.g. a wide establishing panel on top, two or three mid panels, a strong panel at the bottom). Each panel contains one story beat with the characters in scene; rectangular narration/caption boxes sit in panel corners and speech bubbles carry dialogue. Panel borders are clean and consistent. Reading order flows left-to-right, top-to-bottom. Cinematic, clear, character-driven; keep faces and costumes consistent with the attached character references.

templates.name: Character Reference Card
templates.structure_block: CHARACTER CARD layout (richly annotated identity sheet). A large hero figure of the character stands down the LEFT column, full height. The character-s NAME is set large at the top-left as a masthead with a one-line title beneath it. Across the TOP-RIGHT runs a row of 3-4 small head-and-shoulders EXPRESSION studies, each labelled with one emotion word. The RIGHT and lower areas are filled with small framed annotation blocks connected by thin rules: 'At a Glance' bullet traits, a 'Details / personal items' cluster of little object sketches with captions, an 'Always With Her' pair of signature items, a 'Strengths & Struggles' two-column list, a horizontal 'A Day in the Life' strip of 4-5 tiny vignettes with numbered captions, and a bottom row of extreme CLOSE-UP detail crops (jewellery, hair, hands, feet) each captioned. A decorative border frames everything. Dense, museum-catalogue-meets-field-journal, but every block readable. The big figure must exactly match the attached character reference.

templates.name: Envelope Cover

content_slots.instruction: Open me to begin the search.

templates.structure_block: ENVELOPE COVER layout. The LOCATION NAME is set large across the upper third as a hand-titled banner. A central framed vignette illustrates the location (an evocative establishing scene of the place). A wax-seal / round stamp motif and a small postmark sit over one corner as if the envelope were posted. A thin instruction line ('open me to begin') runs near the bottom, and a small coloured tab/dot in a corner signals this envelope-s guna colour. A decorative double border frames the page. Mysterious, tactile, invitational.

templates.name: Clue / Story Letter
templates.structure_block: LETTER layout. Ornate decorative flourishes fill the four corners and a fine rule frames a central writing field. The letter BODY is set as several short paragraphs of period correspondence filling most of the page with comfortable margins, ragged-right, intimate. A salutation sits at the top and a signature line with a small dash-name sits at the bottom-right. Optionally one tiny marginal doodle. The text is the hero and must be fully readable; the page feels like a real posted letter.

templates.name: Vintage Map Sheet
templates.structure_block: MAP SHEET layout. A single aged cartographic map fills the whole page edge-to-edge. A compass rose sits in one upper corner; a fine grid with edge coordinates runs across the sheet; a titled cartouche (place name + scale) sits in a lower corner; a small legend box lists symbol meanings. Numbered/lettered markers and small pictographic symbols dot the terrain at key points, with a few hand-drawn route lines or currents. Antique survey-map feel, dense but legible, the cartography is the hero.

templates.name: Map-Symbols Legend + Hidden Clue
templates.structure_block: LEGEND SHEET layout. A tidy grid of small hand-drawn map SYMBOLS, each paired with its label, arranged in even rows (about 3-4 columns) down the page. Below the grid sits a short hand-written clue line with one or two words deliberately struck-through/replaced so the reader must decode the real instruction. A side tab carries a small place-name. Clean reference-chart feel; the symbols double as a cipher key for the map sheets.

templates.name: Cipher / Puzzle Sheet
templates.structure_block: PUZZLE SHEET layout. A short instruction line at the top, then the PUZZLE BODY filling the centre: for pigpen, the pigpen key-grids plus a line of encoded symbols; for alphabet-blanks, rows of symbol-clues each followed by blank underscores to fill; for word-search, a square grid of letters with a small word list; for numbered hints, a clean numbered 1-10 list of riddle lines. A tiny coloured note in a corner hides the real answer/keyword. A decorative border frames the page. Crisp and solvable, plenty of working space.

templates.name: Guna Balance Sheet (per location)
templates.structure_block: GUNA BALANCE layout. A centred title 'THE THREE GUNAS' with the subtitle 'RAJAS - TAMAS - SATTVA' across the top, a small three-part alchemical emblem beneath it. The CENTRE-RIGHT holds a 'Guna Balance' panel with THREE vertical gauge meters side by side (one warm/Rajas, one dark/Tamas, one pale/Sattva), each filled to its percentage with the number printed below. The LEFT column holds a 'Place Personality' block: three small icon+label rows describing how dominant each guna is here. A framed 'Essence of this Place' caption runs along the bottom. A decorative border frames the page. Reads like an instrument panel for the soul of a location; the same template, only the percentages and text change per location.

templates.name: Hidden-Text Puzzle (natural surface)
templates.structure_block: HIDDEN-TEXT layout. A natural textured surface fills the entire page edge-to-edge (concentric tree-rings, a web of leaf veins, a carved temple/haveli door, or an aged postcard back). Woven subtly INTO that texture - following the rings, the veins, the carved panels, or the postmark lines - are faint letters/words forming a hidden message that only reveals itself on careful looking. The surface reads first as pure texture; the message is camouflaged, never an obvious caption. Immersive and single-image.

templates.name: Line-Drawing Clue (jharokha / steps)
templates.structure_block: LINE-DRAWING layout. A single clean black-outline architectural drawing (an ornate Rajasthani jharokha window, or a flight of carved haveli steps) fills the page on a plain ground, colouring-book clarity. The ornament carries a countable/decodable clue (repeated motifs, numbered steps, a pattern that hides a number or letter). Precise, uncoloured, elegant; the architecture is the hero and the clue lives in its detail.

templates.name: Site Plan / Blueprint
templates.structure_block: SITE-PLAN layout. A measured top-down architectural site plan fills the page: a titled header strip with technical coordinates, the plan itself (outer boundary wall, gates, marked structures, a central complex, a marketplace row) drawn as labelled footprints, a numbered LEGEND box in a lower corner, a 'Site Notes' text box opposite it, and a compass rose. Thin technical linework, antique survey aesthetic, everything labelled. The plan is the hero and one marked location hides the clue.

templates.name: Single Guna-Code Puzzle Piece (4x4cm)
templates.structure_block: PUZZLE PIECE layout. A small square tile. The FRONT shows a single CODE WORD set boldly and centred, tinted in this piece-s guna colour, with a tiny corner index number. (The BACK, when generated, shows one slice of a larger picture so that all pieces together tile into a single image.) Bold, legible at thumbnail size, unmistakable colour-coding by guna.

templates.name: Cut-Out Sheet of Puzzle Pieces

content_slots.pieces: [up to ~12 code words of one guna colour]

templates.structure_block: CUT-OUT SHEET layout. An even grid of equal SQUARE tiles (with faint dashed cut-lines and tiny scissor marks between them) fills the page. Each square holds one centred code word tinted in the sheet-s guna colour with a small index number. Uniform sizing, generous cut margins, print-and-cut friendly. The grid is the hero.

templates.name: Final Assembly Solution (Pancha Mahabhutas)
templates.structure_block: FINAL ASSEMBLY layout. The 22 square code-tiles shown arranged into the correct solution pattern (a centred diamond/cross), their backs together forming ONE complete picture of the Pancha Mahabhutas (the five elements). A short caption names the reveal. A decorative border frames the page. Triumphant solution diagram; the assembled picture is the hero.

templates.name: Make-Your-Own Mask Template
templates.structure_block: MASK TEMPLATE layout. A single symmetrical face-mask shape centred on the page, sized to a child-s face, with clearly marked EYE holes and small dashed CUT lines around the outline and fold/tab marks. The mask surface carries the motifs and colour of one guna spirit. Faint dotted guide lines and a tiny 'cut here / punch here / tie string' note sit at the edges. Print-and-make friendly; the mask shape is the hero.

templates.name: Loose Jaisalmer Map Card
templates.structure_block: MAP CARD layout. A keepsake map of the quest region fills the card: the haveli marked at the centre with concentric rings of meaning spreading outward, the eight quest locations marked and named around it, a compass rose, a titled cartouche, and small connecting paths. Doubles as the player-s board for tracking the search. Antique, collectible feel; the map is the hero.
